about_section_desc: My journey in engineering and technology is a continuous path of growth and evolution, built on daily perseverance and an insatiable passion for learning. I firmly believe that true excellence happens when deep field experience blends with digital innovation, turning every challenge into a genuine opportunity and a lasting, impactful value.
about_para1: I combine solid field-engineering fundamentals with a growing command of AI systems to build practical solutions for real oil & gas challenges, optimizing operations from reservoir simulations to surface separations.
